text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks by thinking about what could go wrong in a project or business. Once you know the risks, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also important to have contingency plans, which are backup plans in case something fails. Finally, you should monitor the situation regularly, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps people and companies avoid serious problems and feel more confident about the future.
